doc.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023

title: Closing remarks and goodbyes
summary: Gafa says he would not change anything and will play as long as the phone rings.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well this has been a fascinating hour, Al, and I appreciate your time and congratulations on your career. I find it very uplifting that you’ve managed to do everything that you love.

I’ll tell you what, I would not change one thing. Okay? Not — some things don’t always go smoothly but I would not change it. It’s been a really great ride and I’m going to keep it — as long as the phone is ringing I’m going to be playing.
Good for you. All right, thanks a lot for your time. I’ll pause and we’ll say our good- byes.
